# Flutter Beta

This mod adds a Flutter beta dev environment to code-server and openvscode-server, to be installed/updated during container start. The environment is already configured to run browser apps.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-flutter
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-flutter|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

```
flutter create myapp
cd myapp
flutter run --web-port=8989
```

Open a browser pointing to:

```
https://my-code-server-host.com/proxy/8989

or

https://8989.my-code-server-host.com
```

When editing the code, press r and refresh the web page, or install the Flutter extension for code-server or openvscode-server.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-flutter/
